description: Move up to 200 items into one existing folder, keeping names. Without confirmed: plan and problems only. With confirmed=true: moves only if no problems. With confirmed=true the server first asks the user to approve the exact list, and moves nothing if the plan changed meanwhile.

confirmed.description: Plan/apply switch: false or absent returns the plan only and changes nothing; true applies it after the server has asked the user to approve the exact list.

destinationFolder.description: Existing folder (not a full new path).

name: drive_bulk_move
title: Move many items
